bomImport.title: Import Migration Tool data for selected BOMs
bomImport.description: Fetches mappings and item headers only for the selected BOMs and all their children. Every other item keeps the Migration Tool data of the previous snapshot, so you can import BOM by BOM. Swing data is reused from the previous snapshot.

overview.title: Overview
overview.noClassModel: The latest analysis has no class model yet. Upload the five Bluestar files (Bluestar reference) and run the analysis again.

launcher.bomTypesPlaceholder: Type a code and press Enter

runs.title: Runs
runs.selectRun: Select a run to see its steps.

bronze.title: Bronze snapshots
bronze.empty: No Bronze snapshot yet. Start a sync.

swing.title: Swing BOM
swing.noLines: No GSST00 lines with this parent item.

swingImport.title: Import from Swing
swingImport.description: Reads the complete BOM (GSST00) and item master (GSAR00) from Swing into a new snapshot and analyses it. Read-only: nothing is written to Swing. Migration Tool data is reused from the previous snapshot.

mtImport.title: Import from Migration Tool
mtImport.description: Reads workspace mappings and item headers (incl. migration approval) from the Migration Tool into a new snapshot and analyses it. Read-only: nothing is written to the Migration Tool. Swing data is reused from the previous snapshot, so import Swing data first.
mtImport.bulkOff: No – one call per Migration Tool item
mtImport.perItem: Only items loaded in the Migration Tool are imported (its item list), not every Swing item. Without a bulk mapping endpoint their mappings are fetched one item at a time, so each import fetches all of them again. To refresh only some BOMs, select them on the Swing BOM page.

waves.readinessEmpty: No top BOMs. Import Migration Tool data for some BOMs and make sure a Bluestar reference is uploaded.
waves.createHint: Tick top BOMs in the grid above. A wave exports each BOM with all its children; the gate checks them before export.

waves.treeTruncated: Large BOM: only part of the {{total}} items is shown.

typeChanges.title: Type changes
typeChanges.description: Swing FIXED items that inherit attributes from a parent must become CONFIGURABLE in Bluestar. An Approver confirms each change; the decision is reset when the inherited attributes or the Swing type change.
typeChanges.confirmText: The decision is recorded with your name and applies until the inherited attributes or the Swing type of the item change.
